svg.text: CONCEPTUAL ROUTE LAYOUT · Arrows show route direction. Position and line length are schematic, not surveyed.
Topology traces do not verify strand-level connectivity. Confirm splices, tap/splitter specifications and light levels separately.
Linked to saved fiber plant Fiber Plant Design 1 / R001. Scoped view: All. Review drawing geometry; optical connectivity is defined by the saved termination register.
